earlierPasses.notes: REPLACES the first pass (Bear Creek Diversion Dam, from a 1999 Hilgard-Gabb multi-peak trip). The two peak-specific day reports use Bear Ridge, which is the west-side day approach. The USFS 'Bear Ridge Cutoff' point and climber.org's BEARCT parking coincide within ~25 m, but the Bear Ridge Trailhead is described as near the dam vista point (EDISN3 37.36735,-118.98339, ~600 m NE), so the coordinate is the trail's start, not a surveyed trailhead sign. A 2023 report started from Mosquito Flat (east side, camp near Mono Creek). Diversion Dam remains a valid alternative for a Hilgard Lake start.

text.description: Reach the cirque of lakes between Black and Red Kaweah from Big Arroyo, then climb the broad west face on loose talus and boulders, keeping well right of Black Kaweah's face. text.approach: Begin at the Old Merritt Lake Trailhead off US-2 (~2,950 ft). Climb via Mahar Creek Ridge to Merritt Lake, then continue over Mt. Mastiff's Southeast Ridge and Mt. Howard's Northeast Ridge (both reported as snow climbs/rock scrambles) before dropping to the Howard-Rock col and climbing Rock Mountain's northeast side.

text.overview: A cross-country mountaineering line up Rock Mountain's northeast side, reached by crossing the Howard-Rock col at the far end of a multi-summit Nason Ridge traverse (Mt. Mastiff - Mt. Howard - Rock Mountain), rather than via the maintained West Route trail.
text.descent: From the summit, descend the South Ridge and East Slope toward Rock Lake, picking up the maintained Rock Mountain Trail in the Rock Lake basin and following it down the switchbacks to the Rock Mountain Trailhead on US-2 (a different trailhead than the Old Merritt Lake start, so a car shuttle or hitch on US-2 is typically needed).

priorPass.notes: No official point named Old Merritt Lake. Descent ends at the Rock Mountain Trailhead (USFS 47.775232,-120.957772), a different one, so the route needs a shuttle. Needs placement by you.
